Prior to that she spent 4 years at Refresh, originally in Manchester, before moving to London to become Client Services Director

But after an horrific tragedy, the regulator has launched a criminal investigation Inspectors downgraded Berrycroft Manor in 2022 , but its 'good' rating was restored following an inspection in autumn 2024. As the Stockport facility appeared to be back on the up, the family of Maureen O'Callaghan were looking for the right care home to move her into They settled on Berrycroft Manor after being 'promised 24-hour care' for the 78-year-old, at a cost of '£1,600 a week', son Nick O'Callaghan told South Manchester Coroner's Court. Maureen had been physically active, but dementia was cruelly taking its toll on her "At the start she was excited to go in the home," granddaughter Olivia O'Callaghan said. "She knew it was what she needed." But over the course of 2025, things 'went downhill' for Maureen, whose mental health deteriorated. evidence_packet.evidence_text: Bolton Car Boot Sale is one of the North West's biggest weekly boot sales, held in the hardstanding car park of the Macron Stadium (formerly Reebok), Burnden Way, Horwich, Bolton BL6 6JW. It runs every Sunday from February right through to December, drawing over 300 sellers and thousands of bargain hunters each week. Sellers can arrive and set up from 6:00 AM, with buyers welcomed in from 7:00 AM. Entry costs just £1 per car for buyers. Pitches for sellers are £14 for a car, £20 for a van and £3 for a trailer, with regular and corner pitches available on request. Bring exact change to keep the queue moving, and call organiser Andrew on 07470784644 for more details. Expect hundreds of stalls across the concrete hardstanding pitches, so it goes ahead in most weather. On-site you'll find a 5-star catering service, doughnuts and coffee, ice cream and desserts, a meat auction, fresh fruit and veg, plants, and retro sweet stalls. The sale is dog-friendly, has male and female toilets, ample parking, and kids' rides and bouncy castles to keep little ones entertained.
